ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface of the left lobe; right lobe shows a more balanced 50/50 distribution due to angle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field centrally located on the left lobe, bounded by a continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing and lateral edges. Right lobe shows high-contrast mottling with white patches appearing in the mid-section and black intensity dominating the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the fluke center with an approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and shallow valleys (5-12 pixel amplitude) along the entirety of the visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning into an upward-tapering parabolic arc toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the leading edge and distal tips of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, non-parallel linear streaks (low-intensity black on high-intensity white) oriented vertically and diagonally across the central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks (parallel and intersecting scratches) across the left lobe ventral surface; significant irregular notch-like patterns on the right lobe trailing edge.
